fields.description: Cluster whose mail this gateway sends. It provides the SSH key, the relay login and the Stalwart version.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Assigned on first save: g1, g2 and so on under the cluster's default domain, e.g. g1.blr.frappemail.com. It gets an A record in the zone and is what the reverse DNS of the IP must point to.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Display name shown in lists and links, e.g. Bangalore gateway 1. Defaults to the hostname.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Where the server runs, e.g. DigitalOcean BLR1. Informational; placement follows the cluster's regions.
fields.label: Location

fields.description: Management URL of the gateway's own Stalwart: https:// plus the hostname. Suite Cloud pushes configuration here once the certificate is live.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Untick to take the gateway out of service. Pools that list its addresses stop working until another gateway hosts them.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Pending: created, not provisioned. Provisioning: a job is running. Provisioned: installed, waiting for its certificate and API key; checked every 5 minutes and Failed if not reachable within 45. Active: relaying. Failed: the job or health check failed, see Last Error. Disabled: stopped by an operator.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Provisioned
Active
Failed
Disabled

fields.description: Stalwart release the gateway runs. Defaults to the cluster's version. Change it and run Upgrade.
fields.label: Stalwart Version

fields.description: Public IPv4 of the VPS, used for SSH, the gateway's A record and management. The addresses mail leaves from are listed on the pools; this one can be among them. Changing it rewrites the DNS records and requires a new SSH check.
fields.label: IPv4 Address

fields.description: Where this gateway's own Stalwart keeps its queue and settings. A gateway shares nothing with the cluster, so a local RocksDB store is created when left blank.
fields.label: Data Store

fields.description: Administrator account of the gateway's Stalwart, created during bootstrap.
fields.label: Admin Username

fields.description: Generated on save. Logs Suite Cloud in to mint the API key, and is what Show Admin Password (Administrator only) reveals for the gateway's web admin.
fields.label: Admin Password

fields.description: Bearer token Suite Cloud uses to push listeners and connection strategies to the gateway. Minted when provisioning finishes.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Stalwart release the last provisioning or upgrade job installed on this gateway.
fields.label: Installed Version

fields.description: Increases every time the gateway plan is pushed, by a job, Sync Config or a pool change.
fields.label: Config Version

fields.description: When the last provisioning or upgrade job finished successfully.
fields.label: Provisioned At

fields.description: When the gateway plan was last pushed, either by a job or after a pool changed.
fields.label: Last Config Sync At

fields.description: Why the last job, SSH check, health check or configuration push failed. Cleared by the next success.
fields.label: Last Error

fields.description: Last gateway plan pushed, secrets redacted: certificate domain, relay account, one listener and connection strategy per pool. Preview Plan shows what the next push would send.
fields.label: Config Plan
